scene.topic_description:
Situation: At passport control, the learner speaks to a border officer before entering or leaving through the border point. It is the learner's first time flying to London, and this is the interaction they are most worried about because they must answer clearly and stay calm.
Learner: Traveller. Partner: Border officer.
Not in this scene: check-in, baggage questions, security screening, finding the gate, transport in the city.
must_say: give your passport — slot: the document
answer where you are going — slot: the destination
answer why you are travelling — slot: the reason
answer how long you will stay — slot: the length of stay
answer where you will stay — slot: the place
ask whether everything is okay — slot: none
confirm you understand where to go next — slot: the place
must_understand: asks where you are travelling to
asks the purpose of your trip
asks how long you will stay and where you will stay
says you can go through or tells you where to go next

findings.detail: the line names «gate twelve», a filler of p7
the reading «uорк» has letters of another alphabet: о р к
the line names «gate twelve», a filler of p7
the right option «To gate twelve» repeats «to gate» of A's «You can go through. Then go to gate twelve.»

topic.description_target: Answer simple questions at passport control and understand where to go next.
topic.description_native: Responder preguntas simples en el control migratorio y entender adónde ir después.

check.text_target: What does the officer want to know?
check.explanation_native: El agente pregunta a qué lugar viaja.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: What is the purpose of your trip?
messages.text_native: ¿Cuál es el motivo de su viaje?

check.text_target: What does the officer want to know?

options.text_target: Why you are making the journey
options.text_native: Por qué está haciendo el viaje

check.explanation_native: El agente pregunta la razón del viaje.

check.text_target: What does the officer want to know?

options.text_native: La ciudad de la que vino

check.explanation_native: El agente pregunta por la duración de la estancia.

check.text_target: What does the officer want to know?
check.explanation_native: El agente pregunta en qué lugar se alojará.

messages.speaker: B
messages.text_target: Okay, I go towards gate twelve.
messages.text_native: Vale, voy hacia la puerta doce.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_target: You can go through. Then go to gate twelve.
messages.text_native: Puede pasar. Después vaya a la puerta doce.

check.text_target: Where does the officer say to go next?
check.text_native: ¿Adónde dice el agente que vaya después?

options.text_native: La zona de embarque número doce

check.explanation_native: El agente indica que después vaya a la zona de embarque número doce.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_native: Pase, después a la puerta doce.

check.text_target: What does the officer say you can do now?
check.text_native: ¿Qué dice el agente que puede hacer ahora?
check.explanation_native: El agente dice que ya puede pasar el control.

check.text_target: What does the officer ask for?
What does the officer say now?
check.explanation_native: El agente confirma que puede continuar.

questions.explanation_native: El viajero dice que va a Londres.
El viajero dice que viaja por turismo.
El viajero dice que se queda cinco días.

questions.text_native: ¿Dónde se va a alojar el viajero?
options_native: En el piso de un amigo
questions.explanation_native: El viajero dice que se aloja en un hotel.

questions.text_native: Después del control, ¿adónde dice el agente que vaya?
questions.explanation_native: El agente dice que después vaya a la puerta doce.

check.text_native: ¿Adónde dice el agente que vaya después?
check.explanation_native: El agente indica que después vaya a la puerta doce.

messages.speaker: A
messages.text_native: Pase, después a la puerta doce.

check.text_target: What does the officer say you can do now?
check.text_native: ¿Qué dice el agente que puede hacer ahora?

check.explanation_native: El agente confirma que puede continuar.

questions.explanation_native: El agente dice que después vaya a la puerta doce.
